## Primary Core Services & Capabilities
1. 3D & Motion Craft: Product visualization, CGI integration, commercial 3D animation, broadcast graphic packages, Blender, Cinema 4D, After Effects.
2. Brand Worlds & Systems: Brand architecture, design tokens, motion guidelines, dynamic identity systems, agency campaign guides.
3. Performance Creative: Data-driven short-form video ads, hook rate optimization, A/B creative testing suites for Meta and TikTok ad networks.
4. Art Direction & Strategy: Creative leadership, campaign concepting, visual hierarchy audit, commercial pitch decks.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 18, Vite 6, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion (Framer Motion), Three.js / React Three Fiber.
- CMS: Sanity Studio 3 (headless CMS).
- Backend & Deployment: Vercel Serverless Functions, Node.js API routes.
